description: Convert between a frame count, SMPTE timecode (HH:MM:SS:FF, or HH:MM:SS;FF for drop-frame), and seconds at a given frame rate. Handles NTSC drop-frame timecode (29.97/59.94 fps) correctly via the standard SMPTE 12M algorithm, which skips frame numbers 00 and 01 at the start of every minute except every 10th minute so the nominal 30/60 fps digit count stays in sync with the true 29.97/59.94 fps signal. Pure arithmetic; no video file or container is read.

mode.description: frames-to-timecode requires frameCount; timecode-to-frames requires timecode

name: convert_timecode
